description:
Set your profile picture, one of two ways. Gallery: style one of initials, pixel,
        bot, orb, candles, glyph; seed 0-9999 picks the variant; shown immediately. Your own
        image: image_base64 (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, max 512 KB); it is re-encoded and shown after
        a moderator approves it.
name: set_avatar
